The problems we built Reoura to solve

None of these show up on a bill or in an appointment book. That is exactly why they cost so much.

Customers leave quietly

A client who came every three weeks hasn't been in for two months. Nobody noticed, and by the time someone does, she has found another salon.

How Reoura helpsIt learns each customer's own rhythm and flags them the day they run late, ranked by what they are worth to you.

Follow-ups never get sent

You know you should message her. But what do you say, and who has time on a busy Saturday?

How Reoura helpsA message written from her history, in English or Urdu, opens in your own WhatsApp with one tap.

Feedback stops at a star rating

Unhappy customers rarely complain, they just don't return. Happy ones are never asked to leave a Google review.

How Reoura helpsA ten-second rating after every visit. Five stars go to your Google page; problems come straight to you.

Money leaks that nobody sees

No-shows that are never rebooked. Visits checked in but never billed. Discounts given at the counter. Services a regular quietly stopped buying.

How Reoura helpsMissing revenue, shown in rupees, with one clear action for each leak, and only real payments counted as recovered.

Data that never becomes a decision

Bills, bookings, chats and reviews pile up every day, but nothing tells you which service is growing, which ads bring loyal customers, or where to focus.

How Reoura helpsPlain-language insights every week, and a short list of what to fix first.

How it works

Your team keeps working the way it does today. Reoura runs quietly in the background and brings you only what needs attention.

  1. Record visits as usual

    Bookings, check-in and billing happen in Reoura, so nothing extra to enter.

  2. Learn each rhythm

    Every customer gets a timeline and their own normal gap between visits.

  3. Spot what matters

    Who is late, who is unhappy, and where revenue is slipping.

  4. Act in one tap

    The message is ready. Review it and send it from your own WhatsApp.

  5. See what came back

    Customers won back and revenue recovered, counted from real payments.

Questions owners ask us

Something else on your mind? Message us and we will answer the same day.

Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?

No. Reoura prepares each message and opens it in the WhatsApp you already use, on your phone or computer. Your staff simply press send, so there are no per-message fees.

Will it work in Urdu?

Yes. Every message can go in English or Urdu, depending on what each customer prefers, and the pages your customers open to confirm, rebook or rate are in their language too.

What about my existing customer list?

Import it from an Excel sheet or your phone contacts. During your free month we help you set up your services, staff and customers so you can start straight away.

How is missing revenue worked out?

From your own records: what each customer usually spends, how often they usually come, missed appointments, unbilled visits and discounts. Money only counts as recovered when that customer actually pays again.

Is my customers' data private?

Each business's data is kept separate and is only visible to your team, with roles for owners, managers, front desk and staff, and a full log of who did what. AI features only see totals and feedback text, never names or phone numbers.

What devices does it run on?

Any phone, tablet or computer with a browser. Nothing to install, and it works in light or dark mode.

Your customers are already telling you what to do next. Reoura helps you listen.
